accepted.sentence: In Filipino pininyahang manok, sweet, juicy chunks simmer with chicken and aromatics, giving the stew a fruity counterpoint.
Some Thai-style fried rice is presented in a hollowed outer casing, which serves as a decorative bowl for the meal.
A fresh wedge often garnishes cocktail glasses, adding color and a tropical accent to the presentation.
Kitchen scraps can be composted, where microbial breakdown turns them into organic matter for garden soil.
A concentrated protease preparation from the plant’s stems is used medically to remove dead tissue from severe burns.
In parts of Mexico, vendors serve juicy chunks with chili powder and lime as a sweet-tart street snack.
Blended with rum and coconut cream, its juice forms the familiar base of a piña colada cocktail.
Pieces can be stirred into plain yogurt, adding fruity sweetness and acidity to breakfast bowls or snacks.
